title: Application and Adaptation of Arc-Based Welding Processes to Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing: A Review
authors: Ahmed Nabil Elalem, Husam Alrehaili, Mohammad Azad Alam, Sufian Raja, Azim Uddin
abstract: Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM) has emerged as one of the most industrially scalable arc-based metal additive manufacturing (AM) technologies, using established Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW), Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (GTAW), and Plasma Arc Welding (PAW) processes to deposit metallic material layer-by-layer into near-net-shape components. This review presents a physics-based examination of the adaptation of traditional welding processes for AM applications, with emphasis on: (i) the thermodynamic and metallurgical principles governing melt pool formation, solidification, and solid-state transformations; (ii) the thermal and solidification features that WAAM shares with multi-pass welding and those that are distinctive to WAAM, with particular attention to the temperature gradient-to-solidification-rate ratio (G/R) and its role in controlling grain morphology; (iii) deposition path strategies and their influence on heat distribution and microstructural homogeneity; (iv) arc metal transfer modes and their thermal implications for AM; and (v) mechanisms of defect formation including porosity, solidification cracking, residual stress, and geometric deviation. Unlike general WAAM reviews, this article specifically positions conventional arc welding processes as the metallurgical and thermal foundation of WAAM and critically examines how their operating principles are transformed under repeated layer-by-layer deposition. Key governing equations linking process parameters to microstructure and properties are presented. Among GMAW variants, Cold Metal Transfer (CMT) provides low heat input, controlled droplet transfer, and low spatter, whereas GTAW and PAW allow wire feed and arc power to be set independently; the preferred process therefore depends on the alloy, required deposition rate, geometry, and surface quality. A synthesis of findings across ferrous and non-ferrous alloy systems is presented, together with knowledge gaps and future directions toward closed-loop adaptive WAAM systems.

infographic.key_insight: WAAM repurposes conventional arc-welding physics—especially heat input, melt-pool dynamics, and solidification control—to build near-net-shape metal parts layer by layer.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The review helps engineers choose and tune GMAW, GTAW, or PAW variants to balance deposition rate, microstructure, defect risk, and surface quality in scalable metal additive manufacturing.
method: Physics-based review of WAAM as an adaptation of welding processes
Compares thermal/solidification behavior through G/R, heat distribution, and deposition strategy
Synthesizes arc transfer modes, defect mechanisms, and alloy-specific process choices
infographic.evidence_signal: The paper is a literature review that compiles governing equations and cross-system findings rather than reporting a new experimental dataset.
infographic.watch_item: Process selection is highly alloy- and geometry-dependent, so results from one WAAM setup may not transfer directly without recalibrating heat input and toolpath strategy.
infographic.paper_title: Application and Adaptation of Arc-Based Welding Processes to Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing: A Review

zh-Hans.title: 基于电弧焊工艺的应用与适应于电弧增材制造：综述
zh-Hans.abstract: 丝材电弧增材制造（WAAM）已成为最具工业可扩展性的基于电弧的金属增材制造（AM）技术之一，它利用成熟的气体保护金属电弧焊（GMAW）、钨极气体保护电弧焊（GTAW）和等离子弧焊（PAW）工艺，将金属材料逐层沉积为近净成形构件。本文从物理机理角度考察了传统焊接工艺向AM应用的适应过程，重点包括：（i）控制熔池形成、凝固和固态相变的热力学与冶金学原理；（ii）WAAM与多道焊所共有的热与凝固特征，以及WAAM所特有的特征，特别关注温度梯度与凝固速率之比（G/R）及其在控制晶粒形貌中的作用；（iii）沉积路径策略及其对热分布和微观组织均匀性的影响；（iv）电弧金属过渡模式及其对AM的热学影响；以及（v）包括气孔、凝固裂纹、残余应力和几何偏差在内的缺陷形成机制。不同于一般WAAM综述，本文将传统电弧焊工艺明确定位为WAAM的冶金与热学基础，并批判性地考察其在重复逐层沉积条件下工作原理如何发生转变。文中给出了将工艺参数与微观组织和性能联系起来的关键控制方程。在GMAW各变体中，冷金属过渡（CMT）具有低热输入、受控液滴过渡和低飞溅的特点；而GTAW和PAW允许单独设定送丝速度和电弧功率；因此，优选工艺取决于合金类型、所需沉积速率、几何形状和表面质量。本文综合了铁基和非铁基合金体系中的研究结果，并总结了知识空白以及迈向闭环自适应WAAM系统的未来方向。

infographic.key_insight: WAAM重新利用传统电弧焊物理机制——尤其是热输入、熔池动力学和凝固控制——逐层构建近净成形金属零件。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该综述有助于工程师选择并调校GMAW、GTAW或PAW变体，以在可扩展金属增材制造中平衡沉积速率、微观组织、缺陷风险和表面质量。
method: 基于物理机理的WAAM综述，将其视为焊接工艺的适应性应用
通过G/R、热分布和沉积策略比较热与凝固行为
综合电弧过渡模式、缺陷形成机制和合金特定工艺选择
infographic.evidence_signal: 本文为文献综述，汇编了控制方程和跨体系研究结果，而非报告新的实验数据集。
infographic.watch_item: 工艺选择高度依赖合金和几何形状，因此某一WAAM方案中的结果不能直接移植到其他方案，通常需要重新校准热输入和刀具路径策略。

title: High-resolution topology-preserving instance segmentation network for vision-based measurement system of dense welding material stubs
authors: Xinyu Chen, YuChao Chen, Yan Ren, Guangming Lv, Meng Zhang, Wang Yuan
abstract: Abstract Accurate counting and morphological analysis of welding electrodes and wire stubs are essential for warehouse data management in welding factories. However, the visual recognition of welding material stubs in real-world industrial applications is frequently hindered by issues such as missed detections, false detections, and imprecise boundary localization. To address these metrological and visual perception challenges, this paper proposes a novel High-resolution Topology-Preserving Instance Segmentation Network (HTP-Net). The proposed end-to-end architecture seamlessly integrates three core designs to realize precise decoupling and robust counting of dense targets.Specifically, a Wavelet-Driven Edge-Preserving (WEP) module is designed to retain subtle physical boundaries without loss during feature downsampling. Concurrently, a Long-Range Topology Representation Block (LTR-Block) mitigates topological disconnections resulting from extreme target slenderness by global context modeling. Finally, an Orientation-Driven Instance Segmentation Head (ODI-Seg) leverages rotational geometric priors to fundamentally resolve excessive NMS and overlapping mask artifacts. Notably, across both our custom and public datasets of dense slender materials, HTP-Net achieves substantial performance gains over existing methods, improving mAP 50 scores by at least 1.2% and up to 55.3%. Furthermore, we developed an intelligent counting system for welding materials powered by the proposed model, which has been deployed and validated in a real-world factory environment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the integrated system achieves average recognition accuracies of 99% and 94% for electrode and wire stubs, respectively.

infographic.key_insight: HTP-Net improves dense welding-stub segmentation by preserving fine edges, global topology, and object orientation to reduce missed detections and overlapping masks.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The model enables more reliable warehouse counting and morphological inspection of welding electrodes and wire stubs in real factory settings.
method: WEP module keeps subtle boundaries through wavelet-based downsampling.
LTR-Block adds long-range context to preserve topology in slender, crowded targets.
ODI-Seg uses rotational priors to reduce NMS errors and mask overlap.
infographic.evidence_signal: On custom and public dense-slender-target datasets, HTP-Net improved mAP50 by at least 1.2% and up to 55.3%, with deployed factory recognition accuracy reaching 99% for electrodes and 94% for wire stubs.
infographic.watch_item: Performance may depend on careful deployment tuning for industrial imaging conditions, especially when target density, occlusion, or orientation varies from the training data.
infographic.paper_title: High-resolution topology-preserving instance segmentation network for vision-based measurement system of dense welding material stubs

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度焊接材料料头视觉测量系统的高分辨率拓扑保持实例分割网络
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 准确计数和形态分析焊接电极与焊丝料头对于焊接工厂的仓储数据管理至关重要。然而，在真实工业应用中，焊接材料料头的视觉识别常常受到漏检、误检以及边界定位不精确等问题的阻碍。为应对这些计量与视觉感知挑战，本文提出一种新的高分辨率拓扑保持实例分割网络（HTP-Net）。所提出的端到端架构无缝集成三项核心设计，以实现密集目标的精确解耦和鲁棒计数。具体而言，设计了波let驱动的边缘保持（WEP）模块，以在特征下采样过程中无损保留细微物理边界。同时，长程拓扑表征块（LTR-Block）通过全局上下文建模，缓解由目标极端细长特性引起的拓扑断裂。最后，方向驱动的实例分割头（ODI-Seg）利用旋转几何先验，从根本上解决过度NMS和重叠掩膜伪影问题。值得注意的是，在我们自建和公开的密集细长材料数据集上，HTP-Net 相较现有方法取得了显著性能提升，mAP 50 分数至少提高 1.2%，最高提高 55.3%。此外，我们基于所提出模型开发了一个用于焊接材料的智能计数系统，并已在真实工厂环境中部署和验证。大量实验表明，该集成系统对电极料头和焊丝料头的平均识别准确率分别达到 99% 和 94%。

infographic.key_insight: HTP-Net 通过保留细微边缘、全局拓扑和目标方向，提高了密集焊接料头分割能力，从而减少漏检和重叠掩膜。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该模型能够在真实工厂场景中，为焊接电极和焊丝料头提供更可靠的仓储计数与形态检测。
method: WEP 模块通过基于小波的下采样保持细微边界。
LTR-Block 通过引入长程上下文来保持细长、拥挤目标的拓扑结构。
ODI-Seg 利用旋转先验减少 NMS 错误和掩膜重叠。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在自建和公开的密集细长目标数据集上，HTP-Net 的 mAP50 至少提高 1.2%，最高提高 55.3%；在实际工厂部署中，电极识别准确率达到 99%，焊丝料头识别准确率达到 94%。
infographic.watch_item: 性能可能取决于工业成像条件下的精细部署调优，尤其是在目标密度、遮挡或方向与训练数据不一致时。

title: Causal discovery of signal morphology drivers in steel resistance spot welding: a high-dimensional data analysis
authors: Hendrik Schulz, M. Stender
abstract: Abstract Resistance spot welding is a primary joining technique in the automotive and general metal manufacturing industries due to its cost-efficiency and potential for automation. As manufacturing transitions to Industry 4.0, an unprecedented volume of high-frequency process data is recorded. Recent advances rely on machine learning to correlate process data with weld quality. However, existing correlational models are typically trained under restricted laboratory conditions, lacking both physical interpretability and generalization across heterogeneous stack-up configurations with varying materials, coatings, thicknesses, and electrode guns. Here we show that by applying a two-phase causal discovery framework and time series clustering to 15,096 representative profiles derived from over 1.8 million welds, one can extract the structural dependencies of signal morphology from multicollinear stack-up configurations. Increased alloying content is associated with accelerated localized heating, advancing dynamic resistance peaks and suppressing secondary peaks in press-hardened steel. Sheet thickness proportionally scales dynamic resistance, displacement, and force amplitudes, while serving as a primary indicator for post-expansion stability. Reducing tip face diameter from 8 to 6 mm increases the initial resistance peak by 9 % and alters post-expansion mechanics. Finally, at a constant thickness, internal faying surface quantity remains statistically insignificant to macroscopic resistance.

infographic.key_insight: A two-phase causal discovery and time-series clustering analysis reveals that weld signal morphology in resistance spot welding is driven mainly by material alloying, sheet thickness, and electrode tip size rather than by faying-surface count.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results provide physically interpretable process levers for improving weld monitoring and quality control across heterogeneous automotive stack-up configurations.
method: Causal discovery to separate structural drivers from correlated process effects
Time-series clustering of 15,096 representative profiles
Analysis of a dataset drawn from over 1.8 million welds
infographic.evidence_signal: The study analyzes 15,096 representative profiles extracted from more than 1.8 million welds, linking process variables to resistance, displacement, and force signal morphology.
infographic.watch_item: Because the approach is data-driven and applied across multicollinear stack-ups, deployment should be checked carefully for domain shift across new materials, coatings, and gun setups.
infographic.paper_title: Causal discovery of signal morphology drivers in steel resistance spot welding: a high-dimensional data analysis

zh-Hans.title: 钢电阻点焊中信号形态驱动因素的因果发现：高维数据分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 电阻点焊由于其成本效益高且具备自动化潜力，是汽车和通用金属制造行业中的主要连接技术。随着制造业向工业4.0转型，记录到前所未有规模的高频工艺数据。近年来的进展依赖机器学习将工艺数据与焊点质量关联起来。然而，现有相关性模型通常在受限的实验室条件下训练，缺乏物理可解释性，也无法在材料、涂层、厚度和电极焊枪各不相同的异质叠层配置之间实现泛化。本文表明，通过对来自超过180万次焊接的15,096条代表性轮廓应用两阶段因果发现框架和时间序列聚类，可以从多重共线的叠层配置中提取信号形态的结构依赖关系。合金化含量增加与局部加热加速相关，在热成形钢中表现为动态电阻峰提前，并抑制次级峰。板材厚度与动态电阻、位移和力的幅值成比例缩放，同时作为后扩展稳定性的主要指标。将电极端面直径从8 mm减小到6 mm，会使初始电阻峰提高9%，并改变后扩展力学特性。最后，在厚度恒定的条件下，内部搭接界面数量对宏观电阻在统计上不显著。

infographic.key_insight: 两阶段因果发现与时间序列聚类分析表明，电阻点焊中的焊接信号形态主要受材料合金化、板材厚度和电极端头尺寸驱动，而非搭接界面数量。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果为在异质汽车叠层配置下改进焊接监测和质量控制提供了具有物理可解释性的工艺调控手段。
method: 因果发现，用于将结构性驱动因素与相关工艺效应分离
对15,096条代表性轮廓进行时间序列聚类
分析来自超过180万次焊接的数据集
infographic.evidence_signal: 该研究分析了从超过180万次焊接中提取的15,096条代表性轮廓，将工艺变量与电阻、位移和力信号形态联系起来。
infographic.watch_item: 由于该方法为数据驱动且应用于多重共线的叠层配置，在新的材料、涂层和焊枪设置上部署时，应谨慎检查领域偏移。

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

infographic.key_insight: A physics-grounded digital twin can rapidly de-risk robotic in-space welding by combining thermal simulation, surrogate models, and control to screen process settings before costly experiments.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework supports safer design of orbital metal-joining systems by predicting weld quality and controller behavior under reduced-gravity, low-pressure conditions.
method: Finite-volume weld-pool model with solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and local-pressure effects
Gaussian-process and neural-network surrogates trained and validated with repeated five-fold cross-validation
Simulated six-axis manipulator and UR5 L-shaped-seam control study using a proportional controller
infographic.evidence_signal: The GP outperformed the neural network on all eight outputs in repeated five-fold cross-validation, 74/80 held-out solver responses fell within 90% predictive intervals, and a three-output GP query took 249 microseconds.
infographic.watch_item: The results are simulation-based, so thermal-vacuum, reduced-gravity, and hardware-in-the-loop testing are still needed to confirm real-world robustness.
infographic.paper_title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins

zh-Hans.title: 基于物理约束数字孪生降低太空金属连接中机器人焊接风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 随着对在轨维护、制造和组装的兴趣日益增长，可靠的金属连接在模块化建造和在轨修复中的重要性重新受到关注。机器人焊接前景良好，但在低重力和低压条件下的运行仍缺乏充分表征，且类飞行测试有限。在英国空间局支持下，ISPARK 项目正在开发一种基于物理约束的数字孪生，用于结构化地降低工艺风险。本文评估了一个基于模型的原型系统，该系统结合了有限体积热焊池模型、高斯过程（GP）和神经网络代理模型，以及一个仿真的六轴机械臂。该降阶模型包含固-液相变、有效热毛细输运以及局部压力参数。重力通过静水压与毛细压之比单独评估，不进入热能方程。在重复的五折交叉验证中，GP 对全部八个输出的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个保留边界工况中，80 个求解器响应里有 74 个落在名义上的 90% GP 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，包括缩放和预测方差计算。在一个仿真的 UR5 L 形焊缝研究中，当行进速度在拐角附近下降时，比例控制器调整协同式电源设定。有限体积重评估发现，12 个闭环工作点全部位于示意性的 1.0-3.0 mm 根部侧宽度带内，而开环工作点中有 9 个位于该范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试前使用该框架筛选焊接条件和控制策略。仍需要开展热真空、定向低重力以及带硬件在环的机器人实验，以评估该模型和控制器。

infographic.key_insight: 基于物理约束的数字孪生可将热仿真、代理模型和控制相结合，在昂贵实验之前快速筛选工艺设定，从而显著降低在轨机器人焊接风险。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架通过预测低重力、低压条件下的焊缝质量和控制器行为，为轨道金属连接系统的更安全设计提供支持。
method: 具有固-液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力效应的有限体积焊池模型
采用重复五折交叉验证进行训练和验证的高斯过程和神经网络代理模型
使用比例控制器的仿真六轴机械臂和 UR5 L 形焊缝控制研究
infographic.evidence_signal: 在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八个输出上均优于神经网络；74/80 个保留求解器响应落入 90% 预测区间内；一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒。
infographic.watch_item: 这些结果基于仿真，因此仍需要热真空、低重力和硬件在环测试来确认其真实环境中的鲁棒性。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A coupled CEL simulation and ANN model can accurately predict friction stir welding quality in HDPE and identify process windows that minimize defects while stabilizing heat and force.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The work provides a practical route to optimize polymer FSW settings—especially rotational speed, traverse speed, and bottom preheating—to improve joint integrity and reduce wormhole formation.
method: 3D Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) model of HDPE friction stir welding
Two multilayer perceptron ANN models trained on experimental temperature and axial-force histories
Process-map generation across rotational speed, welding speed, and preheating conditions
infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved R² values between 0.91 and 0.99, and the CEL model matched experiments in predicting thermal response, axial force, and void formation.
infographic.watch_item: The optimized conditions are validated for the tested HDPE and parameter range, so transfer to other polymers, tool geometries, or larger-scale production may require re-calibration.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯摩擦搅拌焊焊接质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 摩擦搅拌焊（FSW）已被公认为一种有效的热塑性材料连接技术。本研究结合计算方法与机器学习方法，并通过实验结果验证，系统研究了高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）摩擦搅拌焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等FSW特征的预测。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于在转速、焊接速度及底部预热条件变化下模拟HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型通过实验数据进行了验证，在预测孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应方面表现出显著良好的一致性。结果表明，对底表面进行预热可有效降低热梯度并稳定竖直力波动。定量而言，底表面在60 °C下预热将峰值压入力从接近1600 N降低至约1100 N，并将峰值温度从70 °C（未预热）提高到约100 °C，从而平滑了厚度方向梯度并稳定了轴向力分布。与此同时，基于实验数据训练了两个多层感知器人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力的时序响应，其R2介于0.91至0.99之间，表明在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有很高的准确性和较强的泛化能力。计算CEL模拟能够准确预测焊接区形貌，包括搅拌区、热-机影响区和热影响区；然而，结合CEL–ANN的框架能够快速生成工艺图，标示出有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接窗口，其中最佳条件为1500 rpm和30 mm/min并采用60 °C预热，而在1000 rpm且无预热时由于虫洞形成而表现出较差的可焊性。这些研究结果为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了基于工艺的设计指南，并表明将计算建模与机器学习相结合能够实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 耦合的CEL模拟和ANN模型能够准确预测HDPE摩擦搅拌焊质量，并识别出可最小化缺陷同时稳定热和力的工艺窗口。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该工作提供了一条优化聚合物FSW参数的实用途径——尤其是转速、焊接速度和底部预热——以提高接头完整性并减少虫洞形成。

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.

infographic.key_insight: For D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr on DSS 2205, increasing spray distance to 190 mm produced the densest coating and the best corrosion resistance in acidic media.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray distance is a practical process lever for improving coating integrity and extending the service life of stainless-steel components exposed to strong acids.

zh-Hans.title: D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层在酸性环境中对DSS 2205的喷涂距离影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层是陶瓷高硬度与金属高韧性的结合体，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。爆炸喷涂枪（D-gun）喷涂是最具前景的热喷涂技术之一，可制备高质量的陶瓷涂层。Cr3C2-NiCr涂层因其优异的力学性能和耐腐蚀特性而具有较高的应用价值。采用1 M H2SO4在强酸条件下评估了D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的有效性；1 M H2SO4作为标准化实验室电解质，用于评估与工业酸性环境相关的耐腐蚀性能，其中包括喷涂距离等关键工艺变量，而喷涂距离对于确定孔隙率、结合强度、粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能至关重要。采用Cr3C2-NiCr在三种喷涂距离下对双相不锈钢（DSS）2205进行喷涂；分别为170 mm、180 mm和190 mm，以研究Cr3C2-NiCr在酸性条件下的行为。通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化在室温下的1 M H2SO4溶液中评价了涂层的电化学活性。SEM下的表面形貌研究显示涂层呈致密层状结构，孔隙率从170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，表明颗粒熔融程度和涂层致密性有所提高。190 mm处制备的涂层表现出最佳电化学性能，腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），相比之下未涂层基体为2.60 mmpy。所有涂覆试样均具有均匀且致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm是制备DSS 2205上高完整性Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在强酸性工业环境中运行的部件提供更强的耐腐蚀保护。本研究表明，优化D-gun喷涂距离会显著影响DSS 2205上Cr3C2–25NiCr涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。所建立的工艺-微观结构-性能关系为优化D-gun涂层参数、提高强酸环境中的耐腐蚀性提供了科学依据。

infographic.key_insight: 对于在DSS 2205上D-gun喷涂的Cr3C2–NiCr涂层，将喷涂距离增加到190 mm可获得最致密的涂层，并在酸性介质中表现出最佳耐腐蚀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂距离是改善涂层完整性并延长暴露于强酸中的不锈钢部件服役寿命的实用工艺手段。
method: 在170、180和190 mm的喷涂距离下，将Cr3C2–NiCr采用D-gun喷涂到DSS 2205上。
将涂覆样品在室温下暴露于1 M H2SO4中。
评估OCP、EIS、动电位极化以及SEM/孔隙率。
将涂层微观结构和腐蚀速率与未涂层基体进行比较。
infographic.evidence_signal: SEM显示孔隙率从170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，且190 mm涂层的腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），而裸基体为2.60 mmpy。
infographic.watch_item: 所报告的最佳参数仅适用于该涂层体系、酸浓度和测试条件，因此在不同服役环境或喷涂参数下性能可能发生变化。

title: Life Cycle Assessment of Activated TIG Welding: Energy and Environmental Trade-offs in an Iranian Case Study with Sensitivity Analysis
authors: Mahdi Mazloom Farsibaf, Amirmohammad Ghandehariun, Hossein Feiz Arefy, Seyed Moein Fareghi, Farhad Kolahan, Abolfazl Moradian Baghsiah
abstract: Abstract Welding efficiency and environmental performance are critical in industrial applications. This study presents a cradle to gate life cycle assessment (LCA) comparing conventional tungsten inert gas (TIG) welding with activated tungsten inert gas (A-TIG) welding for producing 100 mm bead-on-plate welds on grade 304L stainless steel. In A TIG, a TiO₂ methanol flux allows a lower welding current while achieving a comparable penetration depth. Calculated welding electricity consumption, measured flux-preparation electricity consumption, and material inputs were modeled in SimaPro 9.2 using Ecoinvent 3 datasets. Midpoint impacts were assessed using the EPD 2018 method, and endpoint impacts were assessed using ReCiPe 2016 Hierarchist method. Results show that A-TIG reduced welding electricity consumption by approximately 40% compared with TIG and yielded lower modeled acidification, eutrophication, and global warming potentials. Water scarcity impacts were nearly identical for the two processes. However, However, A-TIG’s normalized photochemical ozone creation potential (POCP) score was 68.1 percentage points higher than TIG’s, with the higher impact set to 100% in each category, primarily because of modeled methanol emissions and upstream flux-production impacts. A one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis covering 30 scenarios showed that the comparative ranking of the two processes remained unchanged within the investigated parameter ranges, with methanol mass identified as the dominant influence on POCP. Endpoint modeling indicated that the human-health category dominated the weighted damage profile. These results represent potential life-cycle impacts rather than measured occupational health effects. This experimental cradle-to-gate LCA of penetration-matched bead-on-plate welding indicates that flux-assisted welding can reduce several impacts associated with electricity consumption while introducing trade-offs related to photochemical ozone creation. These findings support the optimization of activating flux formulations and welding parameters within the investigated conditions, while their applicability to industrial joints requires further validation.

infographic.key_insight: Activated TIG (A-TIG) cuts welding electricity use by about 40% versus conventional TIG, but it can increase photochemical ozone creation impacts because of methanol-based flux emissions and upstream production.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For penetration-matched 304L stainless-steel welds, A-TIG offers a lower-energy path with environmental trade-offs, making flux design and parameter tuning critical for sustainable welding.
method: Cradle-to-gate LCA in SimaPro 9.2 with Ecoinvent 3 datasets
Compared conventional TIG vs. TiO2-methanol A-TIG for 100 mm bead-on-plate welds
Assessed midpoint impacts with EPD 2018 and endpoint impacts with ReCiPe 2016; ran one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis (30 scenarios)
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports lower acidification, eutrophication, and global warming impacts for A-TIG, nearly identical water scarcity, and a 68.1 percentage-point higher normalized POCP score, with the ranking unchanged across sensitivity tests.
infographic.watch_item: Results are cradle-to-gate model estimates for bead-on-plate welds, so they may not directly transfer to industrial joint geometries or real occupational exposure conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Life Cycle Assessment of Activated TIG Welding: Energy and Environmental Trade-offs in an Iranian Case Study with Sensitivity Analysis

zh-Hans.title: 活化 TIG 焊接的生命周期评价：伊朗案例研究中的能源与环境权衡及敏感性分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 焊接效率和环境表现是工业应用中的关键因素。本研究开展了从摇篮到大门的生命周期评价（LCA），比较了常规钨极惰性气体（TIG）焊与活化钨极惰性气体（A-TIG）焊在 304L 级不锈钢上制备 100 mm 短道堆焊（bead-on-plate welds）时的差异。在 A-TIG 中，TiO₂-甲醇助焊剂可在获得可比熔深的同时降低焊接电流。将计算得到的焊接电力消耗、实测助焊剂制备电力消耗以及材料投入，基于 Ecoinvent 3 数据集在 SimaPro 9.2 中建模。采用 EPD 2018 方法评估中点影响，采用 ReCiPe 2016 Hierarchist 方法评估终点影响。结果表明，与 TIG 相比，A-TIG 的焊接电力消耗约降低 40%，且建模得到的酸化、富营养化和全球变暖潜势更低。两种工艺的水资源短缺影响几乎相同。然而，A-TIG 的归一化光化学臭氧生成潜势（POCP）得分比 TIG 高 68.1 个百分点，在每个类别中较高影响被设定为 100%，这主要是由于建模的甲醇排放以及上游助焊剂生产影响。覆盖 30 个情景的一因一敏感性分析表明，在所考察的参数范围内，两种工艺的比较排序保持不变，其中甲醇质量被识别为对 POCP 影响最大的因素。终点建模表明，人体健康类别主导加权损害剖面。这些结果代表的是潜在的生命周期影响，而非实测的职业健康效应。这项针对熔深匹配短道堆焊的实验性从摇篮到大门 LCA 表明，助焊剂辅助焊接可降低与电力消耗相关的若干影响，同时引入与光化学臭氧生成相关的权衡。在所研究条件下，这些发现支持对活化助焊剂配方和焊接参数进行优化，但其在工业接头中的适用性仍需进一步验证。

infographic.key_insight: 与常规 TIG 相比，活化 TIG（A-TIG）可将焊接电力消耗降低约 40%，但由于基于甲醇的助焊剂排放及其上游生产，可能增加光化学臭氧生成影响。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于熔深匹配的 304L 不锈钢焊缝，A-TIG 提供了一条更低能耗的路径，但伴随环境权衡，因此助焊剂设计和参数调节对可持续焊接至关重要。
method: 基于 SimaPro 9.2 和 Ecoinvent 3 数据集开展从摇篮到大门的 LCA
对比常规 TIG 与 TiO₂-甲醇 A-TIG 在 100 mm 短道堆焊中的表现
采用 EPD 2018 评估中点影响、ReCiPe 2016 评估终点影响，并进行一因一敏感性分析（30 个情景）
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，A-TIG 的酸化、富营养化和全球变暖影响更低，水资源短缺几乎相同，而归一化 POCP 得分高 68.1 个百分点；在敏感性测试中，排序保持不变。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Among WC-10Co-4Cr thermal-sprayed coatings, HVOF and HVAF produce the best overall balance of hardness, low wear, and corrosion resistance, with HVAF slightly leading in corrosion performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear- and corrosion-critical components on stainless steel, spray route selection strongly affects coating density, carbide retention, and service life.
method: WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were deposited on 304 stainless steel using APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF.
Microstructure, hardness, friction/wear, and electrochemical corrosion behavior were compared across all four processes.
Performance ranking was established from tribology and corrosion tests rather than a single metric.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports hardness increasing from APS to HVOF/HVAF, wear rate dropping from 7.93×10^-5 to about 1.10–1.17×10^-5 mm3/N·m, and HVAF giving the best corrosion metrics (Ecorr = -0.37 VSCE, Icorr = 1.75 μA/cm², Rp = 20438.5 Ω).
infographic.watch_item: Results depend on the specific WC-10Co-4Cr system and test conditions, so process rankings may shift with feedstock, substrate, spray parameters, or service environment.
