zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、高速氧燃料喷涂和高速空气燃料喷涂 WC-10Co-4Cr 硬质合金涂层的显微组织、耐磨性和耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr 硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性能和耐腐蚀性能。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，在 304 不锈钢基体上制备了 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层。系统研究并比较了 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层的显微组织、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性能。结果表明，APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 制备的硬质涂层的维氏硬度均高于 304 不锈钢，分别为 771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV 和 1162.2 HV。304 不锈钢的体积磨损率约为 (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m。APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层的体积磨损率均低于 304 不锈钢，分别约为 (7.93±0.30)×10-5、(1.51±0.20)×10-5、(1.17±0.10)×10-5 和 (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m。此外，304 不锈钢基体、APS 涂层、DS 涂层、HVOF 涂层和 HVAF 涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为 (0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01) 和 (0.43±0.01)。WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层的磨痕中可见剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承载摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于 APS 涂层。此外，HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层表现出更好的耐磨性能。耐腐蚀性由高到低依次为 HVAF 涂层、DS 涂层、HVOF 涂层和 APS 涂层。HVAF 涂层在此表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 VSCE）、最小的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）以及最大的耐腐蚀性（20438.5 Ω）。APS 涂层在这四种涂层中的耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: 在 WC-10Co-4Cr 热喷涂涂层中，HVOF 和 HVAF 在硬度、低磨损和耐腐蚀性方面表现出最佳的综合平衡，其中 HVAF 的耐腐蚀性能略优。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于不锈钢上耐磨和耐腐蚀要求较高的部件，喷涂工艺路线的选择会显著影响涂层致密性、碳化物保留率和服役寿命。
method: 采用 APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 在 304 不锈钢上沉积 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层。
比较了四种工艺下的显微组织、硬度、摩擦/磨损以及电化学腐蚀行为。
基于摩擦学和腐蚀试验而非单一指标建立了性能排序。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告显示，硬度从 APS 到 HVOF/HVAF 逐步升高，磨损率从 7.93×10^-5 降至约 1.10–1.17×10^-5 mm3/N·m，而 HVAF 的腐蚀指标最佳（Ecorr = -0.37 VSCE，Icorr = 1.75 μA/cm²，Rp = 20438.5 Ω）。
infographic.watch_item: 结果取决于特定的 WC-10Co-4Cr 体系和试验条件，因此工艺排序可能会随原料、基体、喷涂参数或服役环境而变化。

title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC produced the most oxidation-resistant coating on SA516 steel, sharply reducing high-temperature mass gain by forming a dense protective oxide scale.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For boiler and high-temperature service components, selecting HVOF-sprayed Ni-Cr ceramic composite coatings can greatly improve cyclic oxidation life and delay spallation.
method: Compared uncoated SA516 steel with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN coatings applied by HVOF and plasma spray.
Ran cyclic air oxidation tests for 50 cycles at 900°C.
Characterized phases and microstructure using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: The HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating showed the best performance, reducing maximum weight gain by 95.71% relative to bare SA516 steel.
infographic.watch_item: Results are based on laboratory cyclic oxidation at 900°C, so field performance may differ under thermal shock, corrosion mixtures, or long-term service conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢上HVOF与等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的显微组织及高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了采用高速火焰氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术制备的Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂覆SA516锅炉钢的显微组织及高温氧化行为。在900°C的模拟实验室环境中进行了50个循环的空气循环氧化试验，并采用X射线衍射（XRD）、带能量色散光谱（SEM/EDS）的扫描电子显微镜以及X射线元素分布映射分析了由此产生的显微组织和相变。未涂覆的SA516钢发生了严重的氧化层剥落和开裂，形成了未受保护的相（Fe 2 O 3）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层与裸SA516钢相比最大增重降低了95.71%，表明其具有更优异的抗氧化性能。该涂层性能提升归因于形成了致密的保护性氧化层，该氧化层由Cr 2 O 3、TiO 2、NiTiO 4和NiO组成，同时伴随着孔隙率降低和显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC在SA516钢上形成了最耐氧化的涂层，通过形成致密的保护性氧化膜，显著降低了高温增重。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于锅炉及高温服役部件，选择HVOF喷涂的Ni-Cr陶瓷复合涂层可显著提高循环氧化寿命并延缓剥落。
method: 比较了未涂覆SA516钢与采用HVOF和等离子喷涂制备的Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层。
在900°C下进行了50个循环的空气循环氧化试验。
采用XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线元素分布映射对相与显微组织进行了表征。
infographic.evidence_signal: HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层表现最佳，相对于裸SA516钢，其最大增重降低了95.71%。
infographic.watch_item: 结果基于900°C下的实验室循环氧化，因此在热冲击、腐蚀性混合环境或长期服役条件下的现场性能可能不同。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, higher laser power and current intensify molten-pool convection and penetration, while higher travel speed reduces heat input and shrink weld size but can destabilize the arc.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results provide process-window guidance for improving joint quality and arc stability when welding low-thermal-expansion Invar components for aerospace mold applications.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool flow and morphology evolution
High-speed photography of arc behavior during laser-TIG hybrid welding
Parameter sweep over laser power, welding speed, and current
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent trends across 5–6 kW laser power, 0.5–0.8 m/min welding speed, and 150–170 A current, linking each parameter to penetration depth, weld width, flow intensity, and arc shape/stability.
infographic.watch_item: The conclusions are based on a limited parameter range, so transfer to different joint geometries, thicknesses, or shielding conditions should be validated experimentally.
infographic.paper_title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel

zh-Hans.title: 激光-TIG复合焊接因瓦钢时熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 因瓦钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此被广泛用于航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析不足。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影分析了激光-TIG复合焊接因瓦钢过程中不同工艺参数对熔池形貌演变和电弧特性的影响，这为优化因瓦钢焊接工艺提供了重要的理论支持。结果表明，在激光功率5 ~ 6 kW范围内，功率增大会导致更大的反冲压力，促进更大的熔深和匙孔尺寸，强化整体熔池流动，并使电弧在高功率下更易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在焊接速度0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min范围内，较高的速度会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，同时熔池流动速度和冷却速率增加；此外，在较高速度下电弧更易发生变形。在焊接电流150 ~ 170 A范围内，电流增大会增强电弧力，促进焊缝宽度扩展并强化熔池对流；此外，较高电流下电弧更稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在因瓦钢激光-TIG复合焊接中，更高的激光功率和电流会增强熔池对流和熔深，而更高的行进速度会降低热输入、缩小焊缝尺寸，但可能使电弧不稳定。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果为焊接低热膨胀因瓦构件、用于航天模具应用时，改善接头质量和电弧稳定性提供了工艺窗口指导。
method: 熔池流动与形貌演变的数值模拟
激光-TIG复合焊接过程中电弧行为的高速摄影
激光功率、焊接速度和电流的参数扫描
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了在5–6 kW激光功率、0.5–0.8 m/min焊接速度和150–170 A电流范围内的一致趋势，将每个参数与熔深、焊缝宽度、流动强度以及电弧形状/稳定性联系起来。
infographic.watch_item: 这些结论基于有限的参数范围，因此在不同接头几何形状、厚度或保护条件下的适用性应通过实验验证。

title: Microencapsulated Beadlets: A Comprehensive Review
authors: Bhav Saraswat, Jyoti Gupta, Rambabu Sharma
abstract: Microencapsulated beadlets are versatile multiparticulate drug delivery systems designed to incorporate active pharmaceutical ingredients within polymeric matrices, core–shell structures, or functional coatings to achieve improved stability and controlled drug release. These systems combine the advantages of microencapsulation with the flexibility of multiparticulate dosage forms and can be formulated to provide immediate, sustained, delayed, pulsatile, biphasic, or site-specific drug delivery. The present review provides a comprehensive overview of the formulation strategies, preparation techniques, characterization, evaluation, and pharmaceutical applications of microencapsulated beadlets. Various manufacturing methods, including solvent evaporation, coacervation-phase separation, fluid-bed coating, extrusion–spheronization, ionotropic gelation, spray drying, spray congealing, melt-based processes, microfluidics, and electrohydrodynamic atomization, are discussed. Particular emphasis is given to the selection and role of natural, semi-synthetic, synthetic, and biodegradable polymers in controlling drug loading, encapsulation efficiency, particle morphology, mechanical strength, and release behavior. Critical quality attributes, including particle size, size distribution, sphericity, surface morphology, density, porosity, drug content, encapsulation efficiency, swelling behavior, drug–polymer compatibility, solid-state properties, and in vitro drug release, are reviewed. Drug release mechanisms involving diffusion, swelling, erosion, dissolution, pore-mediated transport, and polymer degradation are also examined. Microencapsulated beadlets offer significant advantages, including improved patient compliance, flexible dosing, reduced dosing frequency, enhanced stability, taste masking, and the ability to combine different release profiles within a single dosage form. Despite challenges related to manufacturing reproducibility, scale-up, coating uniformity, and process control, emerging technologies such as quality-by-design, continuous manufacturing, advanced polymeric materials, and microfluidics are expected to further enhance their pharmaceutical applications. Keywords: Microencapsulation; beadlets; microbeads; microspheres; multiparticulate drug delivery; controlled release.
venue: Journal of Drug Delivery and Therapeutics

infographic.key_insight: Microencapsulated beadlets are multiparticulate drug delivery systems that use polymer matrices or core–shell coatings to precisely tune stability, protection, and release profile.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The paper is relevant to coating microstructure and process engineering because beadlet performance depends on material selection, coating uniformity, and controllable manufacturing methods.
method: Review of formation routes: solvent evaporation, coacervation, fluid-bed coating, extrusion–spheronization, ionotropic gelation, spray drying/congealing, melt processes, microfluidics, and electrohydrodynamic atomization.
Comparison of polymer classes, including natural, semi-synthetic, synthetic, and biodegradable systems, for encapsulation efficiency and release control.
Assessment of critical quality attributes such as particle size, morphology, porosity, drug loading, swelling, compatibility, and release kinetics.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract indicates evaluation through standard formulation and performance metrics, especially encapsulation efficiency, solid-state characterization, and in vitro drug release testing.
infographic.watch_item: A key implementation concern is maintaining reproducible large-scale manufacturing, especially coating uniformity and process control during scale-up.
infographic.paper_title: Microencapsulated Beadlets: A Comprehensive Review

zh-Hans.title: 微囊化小丸：一项全面综述
zh-Hans.abstract: 微囊化小丸是一类用途广泛的多颗粒药物递送系统，旨在将活性药物成分包埋于聚合物基质、核壳结构或功能性包衣中，以实现更好的稳定性和可控药物释放。这些系统结合了微囊化的优点与多颗粒剂型的灵活性，可被制备为即时、缓释、延迟、脉冲式、双相或靶向部位的药物递送。本文综述全面概述了微囊化小丸的处方策略、制备技术、表征、评价及其药学应用。文中讨论了多种制备方法，包括溶剂蒸发、凝聚相分离、流化床包衣、挤出–滚圆、离子凝胶化、喷雾干燥、喷雾凝固、熔融法工艺、微流控以及电流体动力雾化。重点阐述了天然、半合成、合成及可生物降解聚合物在控制载药量、包封效率、颗粒形态、机械强度和释放行为中的选择与作用。综述了关键质量属性，包括粒径、粒径分布、球形度、表面形貌、密度、孔隙率、药物含量、包封效率、溶胀行为、药物–聚合物相容性、固态性质以及体外药物释放。还考察了涉及扩散、溶胀、侵蚀、溶解、孔隙介导传递和聚合物降解的药物释放机制。微囊化小丸具有显著优势，包括提高患者依从性、剂量灵活、降低给药频次、增强稳定性、掩味以及能够在单一剂型中组合不同释放特征。尽管在制造重复性、放大生产、包衣均匀性和工艺控制方面仍存在挑战，但质量源于设计、连续制造、先进聚合物材料和微流控等新兴技术有望进一步提升其药学应用。关键词：微囊化；小丸；微珠；微球；多颗粒药物递送；控释。

infographic.key_insight: 微囊化小丸是多颗粒药物递送系统，利用聚合物基质或核壳包衣精确调控稳定性、保护性和释放特征。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该论文与包衣微结构和过程工程密切相关，因为小丸性能取决于材料选择、包衣均匀性以及可控制造方法。
method: 综述成形路线：溶剂蒸发、凝聚、流化床包衣、挤出–滚圆、离子凝胶化、喷雾干燥/喷雾凝固、熔融工艺、微流控以及电流体动力雾化。
比较包括天然、半合成、合成和可生物降解体系在内的聚合物类别，以评估包封效率和释放控制。
评估粒径、形貌、孔隙率、载药量、溶胀、相容性和释放动力学等关键质量属性。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要表明，该研究通过标准的处方与性能指标进行评价，尤其关注包封效率、固态表征和体外药物释放测试。
infographic.watch_item: 一个关键实施问题是在放大生产过程中保持可重复的大规模制造，尤其是包衣均匀性和工艺控制。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: Homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder enables dense, layered cermet coatings, while spray method selection trades off hardness and tribological performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results help optimize WC–Co–Cr coating processing for wear-resistant machine parts operating under high friction and high load.
method: Compared HVOF and detonation spraying for WC–Co–Cr cermet deposition.
Characterized powder morphology, coating microstructure, and phase composition using SEM and EDS.
Evaluated hardness, density, and friction behavior to relate processing to performance.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports a higher average microhardness for detonation-sprayed coatings (1449 HV) and a low friction coefficient for HVOF coatings (Kt = 0.143).
infographic.watch_item: Performance depends strongly on powder quality and spray parameters, so the reported results may not transfer directly to other feedstock morphologies or operating conditions.
infographic.paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING

zh-Hans.title: 采用HVOF和爆炸喷涂制备WC–Co–Cr涂层的结构形成及耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了比较分析。研究包括利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散光谱（EDS）分析初始粉末的形貌，以及涂层的显微组织和相组成。结果表明，采用均匀、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可形成致密的层状结构，并使碳化物相在金属基体中均匀分布。爆炸喷涂可获得更硬的涂层（平均显微硬度1449 HV），而HVOF则可制备出密度高、显微组织均匀且摩擦系数低（Kt = 0.143）的涂层。比较分析证实，涂层的力学和摩擦学性能强烈依赖于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些结果有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，从而提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于在强摩擦和高载荷条件下运行尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: 均匀、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可形成致密的层状金属陶瓷涂层，而喷涂方法的选择则在硬度与摩擦学性能之间形成权衡。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果有助于优化WC–Co–Cr耐磨涂层的制备工艺，适用于在高摩擦和高载荷条件下工作的机械零件。
method: 比较了HVOF和爆炸喷涂用于WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷沉积的效果。
使用SEM和EDS表征了粉末形貌、涂层显微组织和相组成。
评估了硬度、密度和摩擦行为，以关联工艺与性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了爆炸喷涂涂层具有更高的平均显微硬度（1449 HV），而HVOF涂层具有较低的摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。
infographic.watch_item: 性能强烈依赖于粉末质量和喷涂参数，因此所报告结果可能无法直接推广到其他原料形貌或工况条件。

title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Laila Sulyubayeva, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigated the influence of detonation spraying parameters on the structure and tribological and mechanical properties of self-fluxing coatings of the Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C system. The investigated parameters included the barrel filling level (48–68%), the molar ratio of the working gases (O/C = 1.026–1.856), and the inter-shot delay (0–1 s). Morphological analysis of the coatings revealed a characteristic lamellar structure and a dependence of coating thickness and defect formation on the spraying conditions. A lower barrel filling level resulted in a denser coating structure with minimal porosity, whereas medium and high filling levels promoted the formation of microcracks, presumably due to increased residual stresses. Tribological tests showed that the minimum coefficient of friction was obtained at a barrel filling level of 48% (μ = 0.674 ± 0.136) and an O/C ratio of 1.026, but these conditions were also associated with increased wear. The highest wear resistance was obtained at an O/C ratio of 1.856 and an increased inter-shot delay of up to 1 s, resulting in a decrease in the specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m). Roughness analysis showed that increasing the inter-shot delay reduced Ra from 5.00 to 3.60 μm, which may be attributed to a reduction in thermal load and more favorable coating formation conditions. The maximum hardness, up to 905.6 HV, was obtained for a combination of parameters that promoted the formation of a dense structure and strengthening phases. The results indicate that optimizing the detonation spraying parameters requires a trade-off between reducing the coefficient of friction and increasing wear resistance. The findings can be used to develop tech nologies for the restoration and surface strengthening of machine components.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-spraying settings strongly tune the trade-off between dense, hard Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C coatings and their friction/wear performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides practical process windows for restoring and strengthening machine parts with self-fluxing nickel-based coatings.
method: Varied barrel filling level from 48–68%
Adjusted working-gas molar ratio (O/C = 1.026–1.856)
Changed inter-shot delay from 0 to 1 s
infographic.evidence_signal: Testing showed the lowest friction at 48% barrel filling and O/C = 1.026, while the best wear resistance occurred at O/C = 1.856 with 1 s delay, reducing specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m).
infographic.watch_item: Optimizing for low friction can increase wear, so process tuning must balance tribology against residual-stress-driven cracking and porosity.
infographic.paper_title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying

zh-Hans.title: 通过爆炸喷涂制备自熔性镍基涂层的方法开发
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了爆炸喷涂参数对 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 系自熔性涂层组织以及摩擦学和力学性能的影响。所研究的参数包括枪管填充率（48–68%）、工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）以及两次发射间隔（0–1 s）。涂层的形貌分析表明，其具有典型的层状结构，并且涂层厚度和缺陷形成依赖于喷涂条件。较低的枪管填充率导致涂层结构更致密、孔隙率最低，而中等和较高的填充率则促进了微裂纹的形成，这可能归因于残余应力增加。摩擦学测试表明，在枪管填充率为 48%（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136）且 O/C 比为 1.026 时获得了最低摩擦系数，但这些条件也伴随着更高的磨损。最高耐磨性出现在 O/C 比为 1.856 且两次发射间隔增至 1 s 的条件下，此时比磨损率降至 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。粗糙度分析表明，增加两次发射间隔使 Ra 从 5.00 μm 降至 3.60 μm，这可能归因于热负荷降低以及更有利的涂层形成条件。最大硬度高达 905.6 HV，出现在有利于形成致密结构和强化相的参数组合下。结果表明，优化爆炸喷涂参数需要在降低摩擦系数和提高耐磨性之间进行权衡。该研究结果可用于开发用于机器部件修复和表面强化的技术。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂参数会显著调控致密、高硬度 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 涂层与其摩擦/磨损性能之间的权衡关系。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本研究为采用自熔性镍基涂层修复和强化机械零件提供了可操作的工艺窗口。
method: 将枪管填充率调整为 48–68%
调整工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）
将两次发射间隔从 0 调整到 1 s
infographic.evidence_signal: 测试表明，在枪管填充率为 48% 且 O/C = 1.026 时摩擦系数最低；而在 O/C = 1.856 并延长至 1 s 间隔时耐磨性最佳，比磨损率降至 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。
infographic.watch_item: 优化低摩擦性能可能会增加磨损，因此工艺调控必须在摩擦学性能与由残余应力驱动的开裂和孔隙率之间取得平衡。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning delivered the most accurate predictions for UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness, while the multitask neural network offered strong shared-learning performance across related welding outputs.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For welding process optimization, the study shows that model choice depends on the goal: maximum task-specific accuracy favors stacking, while multitask learning is attractive when related targets and data efficiency matter.
method: Compared a multitask neural network (shared hidden layers with task-specific outputs) against stacking ensemble learning.
Predicted three welding performance metrics: UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness from a shared dataset.
Evaluated models using RMSE and R² to assess predictive error and explained variance.
infographic.evidence_signal: Stacking achieved lower RMSE and higher R² across all three targets, with the strongest results for UTS and weld hardness; MTNN still showed solid generalization, especially for weld hardness and HAZ hardness.
infographic.watch_item: The comparative gains depend on the dataset and task correlation, so stacking may require careful validation to avoid overfitting and poor transfer to new welding conditions.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 用于焊接应用中 UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度预测的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习的比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 机械硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和服役性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其中一个模型被设计用于同时处理多个相互关联的任务。与针对每个任务分别训练独立模型不同，MTL 在任务之间共享表示，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保留任务特定差异。在本研究中，我们基于同一数据集，比较了两种先进的机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，用于预测这些参数。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一种特定类型的多任务学习（MTL）模型，它使用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在 MTNN 中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表示使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保持任务特定输出。两种方法均使用 RMSE 和 R<sup>2</sup> 进行评估，以确定其预测精度和整体有效性。结果显示其具有较强的预测能力，其 RMSE 结果分别为 UTS 的 0.1288、焊缝硬度的 0.0886 以及 HAZ 硬度的 0.1125，而 R<sup>2</sup> 值分别为 0.6724、0.9215 和 0.8407。这表明其能够在相互关联的任务中具有良好的泛化能力。堆叠集成学习在单个任务的精度方面优于 MTL：UTS 的 RMSE 为 0.0263，R<sup>2</sup> 为 0.9863；焊缝硬度的 RMSE 为 0.0467，R<sup>2</sup> 为 0.9782；HAZ 硬度的 RMSE 为 0.1109，R<sup>2</sup> 为 0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法在生成高度精确的任务特定预测方面具有良好能力。该比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL 适用于任务相关且数据稀缺的场景，能够实现高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成在需要精确、独立预测的情况下表现更佳。两者都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，并可作为进一步研究混合模型的前驱，这类模型可将两种方法的最佳特征结合起来。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习在 UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度预测方面提供了最准确的结果，而多任务神经网络在相关焊接输出之间表现出强大的共享学习能力。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于焊接工艺优化而言，该研究表明模型选择取决于目标：若追求最大化任务特定精度，则更倾向于堆叠集成；若相关目标和数据效率更重要，则多任务学习更具吸引力。
method: 将多任务神经网络（共享隐藏层并具有任务特定输出）与堆叠集成学习进行比较。
基于共享数据集预测三项焊接性能指标：UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度。
使用 RMSE 和 R² 对模型进行评估，以衡量预测误差和解释方差。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在所有三个目标上，堆叠集成的 RMSE 更低且 R² 更高，其中 UTS 和焊缝硬度的结果最为突出；MTNN 仍表现出稳健的泛化能力，尤其是在焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度方面。
infographic.watch_item: 比较收益取决于数据集和任务相关性，因此堆叠集成可能需要谨慎验证，以避免过拟合以及在新的焊接条件下迁移性能不佳。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings with more circular, well-spread droplets form denser microstructures and show better long-term corrosion and humidity-dependent wear performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray parameters to minimize porosity can improve the durability of Fe-based amorphous protective coatings on carbon steel in corrosive and humid service environments.
method: Prepared Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters.
Compared droplet morphology, coating microstructure, long-term corrosion behavior, and tribological performance under different humidity conditions.
Evaluated wear mechanisms involving Si3N4 balls and water-molecule-assisted tribo-chemical reactions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that droplets with the highest circularity and expansion factor produced fine-lamellar, dense coatings, while higher porosity correlated with reduced corrosion resistance and humidity increased corrosion and wear benefits.
infographic.watch_item: Performance appears sensitive to spray-parameter control and porosity formation, so process repeatability is critical before scale-up or field deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为和磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 通过不同喷涂参数，采用爆炸喷涂法在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀和摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷并形成微结构致密的细片层结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷发生率较高与长期耐腐蚀性能降低相关。此外，在不同湿度条件下，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层的磨损行为起着重要作用。随着湿度条件升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂制备的铁基非晶涂层中，液滴圆度更高、铺展更充分时可形成更致密的微观结构，并表现出更好的长期耐腐蚀性和随湿度变化的耐磨性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂参数以减少孔隙率，可提高铁基非晶防护涂层在腐蚀性和潮湿服役环境中对碳钢的耐久性。
method: 通过不同喷涂参数，采用爆炸喷涂法在Q235碳钢上制备铁基非晶涂层。
在不同湿度条件下，对液滴形貌、涂层微观结构、长期腐蚀行为和摩擦学性能进行比较。
评估涉及Si3N4球和水分子辅助摩擦化学反应的磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要指出，圆度和铺展因子最高的液滴形成了细片层、致密的涂层，而更高的孔隙率与较低的耐腐蚀性相关，且湿度增加有利于降低腐蚀和磨损。
infographic.watch_item: 性能似乎对喷涂参数控制和孔隙形成非常敏感，因此在放大生产或现场部署前，工艺重复性至关重要。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Tuning the flame-spraying O2/C2H2 ratio directly improved Ni–Cr–B–Si coating quality, with higher ratios producing denser, smoother, and better-adhered coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Process-gas control is a practical lever for optimizing flame-sprayed self-fluxing coatings for wear- and corrosion-resistant surface engineering.
method: Flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si self-fluxing coatings onto AISI 321 steel
Varied O2/C2H2 ratio: 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2
Measured microstructure, porosity, roughness, microhardness, and adhesion strength
infographic.evidence_signal: As O2/C2H2 increased, porosity fell from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%, roughness dropped from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, and adhesion rose from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa; peak microhardness was 1051.7 HV at 1.1.
infographic.watch_item: The reported trends are based on a limited set of gas ratios, so the optimum may shift with spray distance, powder feed, substrate condition, or post-treatment.
infographic.paper_title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对基于 Ni–Cr–B–Si 的自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对基于 Ni–Cr–B–Si 的自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的 AISI 321 奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料。涂层通过使用 Metal Coat 6PM-II 系统的火焰喷涂方法沉积。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧/乙炔（O₂/C₂H₂）比调整为 1.0、1.1 和 1.2。喷涂参数采用 Accuraspray 4.0 诊断系统进行监测。对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。提高 O₂/C₂H₂ 比使涂层结构更加致密，孔隙率从 1.97 ± 0.13% 降至 0.90 ± 0.09%。与此同时，表面粗糙度从 4.70 ± 0.09 μm 降至 2.99 ± 0.11 μm，而结合强度从 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa 提高到 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。在 O₂/C₂H₂ 比为 1.1 时获得了最高平均显微硬度 1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 时制备的涂层表现出最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制 O₂/C₂H₂ 比是调控火焰喷涂 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层微观结构和力学特性的有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 调节火焰喷涂的 O2/C2H2 比可直接改善 Ni–Cr–B–Si 涂层质量，更高的比值可获得更致密、更平滑且结合更好的涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 过程气体控制是优化火焰喷涂自熔性涂层、用于耐磨和耐腐蚀表面工程的实用手段。
method: 将 Ni–Cr–B–Si 自熔性涂层火焰喷涂到 AISI 321 钢上
测量微观组织、孔隙率、粗糙度、显微硬度和结合强度
infographic.watch_item: 所报告的趋势基于有限的气体比值范围，因此最佳工艺参数可能会随喷涂距离、粉末送粉量、基体状态或后处理而变化。

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone-implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti-HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti-HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

infographic.key_insight: Distal weight-bearing implants must be designed as coupled biomechanical–biomaterial systems, where geometry, loading, and graded Ti-HAp or other surface interfaces jointly determine fixation durability and osseointegration.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The review informs implant engineers working on load-bearing medical devices by linking finite-element gait loading, coating integrity, and biomaterial interface design to translational performance.
method: Systematic review of DWBI literature plus trend analysis of 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies.
Synthesis of computational modeling, finite element analysis under gait-phase loading, and functionally graded Ti-HAp / FGM concepts.
Comparison of bench, animal, and human evidence to assess translation readiness.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports a quantitative literature trend analysis, but most evidence remains at bench or simulation level, with fewer animal and clinical studies supporting translation.
infographic.watch_item: A major limitation is that graded Ti-HAp and related FGM evidence is mostly indirect or from non-DWBI analog studies, so device-level validation is still needed.
infographic.paper_title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation

zh-Hans.title: 远端承重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面与临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端承重植入物（DWBIs）代表一类临床上新兴的承重医疗器械，其生物材料设计、表面结构与生物力学性能高度耦合。其成功不仅取决于在股骨假肢康复中恢复远端支撑，还取决于金属、陶瓷和复合生物材料界面在促进持久骨-植入物整合的同时承受循环载荷的能力。然而，远端支撑也会改变弯矩、剪应力、微动、涂层耐久性以及骨-植入物界面的生物学需求。本系统综述综合了DWBI概念、几何优化、带步态阶段载荷的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（FGMs）、梯度Ti-HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据以及临床转化路径。我们对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估研究趋势、验证深度和转化就绪度。然而，超过一半的实证证据仍停留在台架或模拟层面，而动物和人体/临床研究构成了较小的验证层。以HAp为中心的表面或块体材料工程占据了相当大的文献比例；然而，关于梯度Ti-HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来自非DWBI生物材料和机理类比研究，支持的是机理上的合理性，而非DWBI特异性验证。从机理上看，DWBI应被理解为一个整合的生物材料-力学系统，将宏观几何、金属/陶瓷表面结构、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态阶段载荷、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定以及临床流程联系起来。转化将需要更贴近患者真实情况的载荷条件、经过验证的有限元分析工作流程、器械级疲劳和涂层完整性测试、标准化的体内终点指标、统一的康复方案，以及由登记数据库支持的临床随访，以将力学上的合理性与持久的生物学固定和患者层面的获益联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 远端承重植入物必须被设计为耦合的生物力学-生物材料系统，其中几何、载荷以及梯度Ti-HAp或其他表面界面共同决定固定耐久性和骨整合。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本综述通过将有限元步态载荷、涂层完整性和生物材料界面设计与转化性能联系起来，为从事承重医疗器械研发的植入物工程师提供参考。
method: 对DWBI文献进行系统综述，并对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行趋势分析。
综合计算建模、步态阶段载荷下的有限元分析以及功能梯度Ti-HAp/FGM概念。
比较台架、动物和人体证据，以评估转化就绪度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 该摘要报告了文献趋势的定量分析，但大多数证据仍停留在台架或模拟层面，支持转化的动物和临床研究较少。
infographic.watch_item: 一项主要局限在于，梯度Ti-HAp及相关FGM证据大多为间接证据或来自非DWBI类比研究，因此仍需要器械级验证。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: A drilled-to-bossed joint geometry combined with optimized DDFW settings substantially improves AA2024-T351 weld strength, while deep learning can predict tensile performance from process parameters.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical route to stronger lightweight aerospace/automotive aluminum joints by pairing geometry-driven mechanical interlocking with AI-guided process optimization.
method: L18 orthogonal array tested friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time.
Compared conventional flat-to-flat joints against a novel drilled-to-bossed geometry in direct drive friction welding.
Trained deep learning models to predict ultimate tensile strength from welding conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The best condition (30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm, drilled-to-bossed geometry, 4 min friction time) achieved 538 MPa tensile strength and 325 MPa torsional strength, and the top model reached R² ≈ 0.81.
infographic.watch_item: The predictive model accuracy is moderate rather than near-perfect, so broader validation on more datasets and operating conditions would be needed before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 利用钻孔-凸台几何与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351在直接驱动摩擦焊中的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要：航空航天和汽车工业对轻质高强材料的需求不断增长，使AA2024-T351等铝合金因其优异的比强度而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中实现可靠接头仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究聚焦于优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。研究引入一种受传统榫卯接头启发的新型钻孔-凸台几何结构，以增强机械互锁并提高焊缝完整性。通过采用L18正交表系统设计实验，评估抗拉强度和扭转强度。实验在定制发动机车床上进行，选取摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、对接表面几何形状和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。同时，实施了包括集成残差网络、紧凑注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络在内的先进深度学习模型，用于基于焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔-凸台几何结构以及4 min摩擦时间的最优参数组合表现出卓越的力学性能，获得了538 MPa的抗拉强度和325 MPa的扭转强度。与传统平面对平面接头相比，钻孔-凸台结构显示出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在深度学习模型中，集成残差网络取得了最高的预测精度，R²值约为0.81，能够有效捕捉工艺参数与焊缝强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.key_insight: 钻孔-凸台接头几何与优化后的DDFW参数相结合，可显著提高AA2024-T351焊接强度，同时深度学习可根据工艺参数预测抗拉性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究通过将几何驱动的机械互锁与AI引导的工艺优化相结合，为获得更强的轻质航空航天/汽车铝合金接头提供了一条可行路径。
method: 采用L18正交表测试摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、对接表面几何形状和摩擦时间。
在直接驱动摩擦焊中，将传统平面对平面接头与新型钻孔-凸台几何结构进行对比。
训练深度学习模型，根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 最佳条件（30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm、钻孔-凸台几何结构、4 min摩擦时间）实现了538 MPa抗拉强度和325 MPa扭转强度，且最佳模型达到R²≈0.81。
infographic.watch_item: 该预测模型的精度为中等水平，而非接近完美，因此在部署之前需要在更多数据集和工况条件下进行更广泛的验证。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed titanium dioxide based coatings can be tuned for roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity by adjusting process parameters, with optimal settings yielding maximum water repellency.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides practical process-parameter guidance for designing functional anti-wetting coating surfaces in thermal spray manufacturing.
method: Varied detonation spraying conditions, especially nozzle passage speed and spray distance.
Measured coating surface roughness, thickness, and contact angle to quantify hydrophobicity.
Fit empirical relationships, including inverse-power and parabolic dependencies, to predict surface characteristics.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports experimentally derived equations linking process parameters to roughness, thickness, and contact angle, enabling prediction of coating performance.
infographic.watch_item: The reported optimums are process- and material-specific, so transfer to other spray systems, substrates, or coating chemistries will require validation.
infographic.paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions

zh-Hans.title: 采用爆炸喷涂在不同工艺条件下获得的钛基涂层表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 基于二氧化钛的金属陶瓷涂层表面性能取决于爆炸喷涂条件而被描述。研究发现，表面粗糙度、表面厚度及其疏水性等性质可在生产过程中通过选择喷涂工艺参数的特定取值来加以控制。确定了爆炸喷涂工艺参数的最佳值，以确保所制备涂层具有最大疏水性。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度随喷嘴通过速度变化，并符合反幂律。粗糙度和接触角随喷涂距离变化，并符合抛物线规律。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，以及确定保证涂层最佳疏水性的最佳喷涂模式。

infographic.key_insight: 通过调节工艺参数，可对爆炸喷涂的二氧化钛基涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性进行调控，最优设置可获得最大的拒水性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为热喷涂制造中设计功能性抗润湿涂层表面提供了实际的工艺参数指导。
method: 改变爆炸喷涂条件，尤其是喷嘴通过速度和喷涂距离。
测量涂层表面粗糙度、厚度和接触角，以量化疏水性。
拟合经验关系，包括反幂和抛物线依赖关系，用于预测表面特性。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了实验获得的方程，将工艺参数与粗糙度、厚度和接触角联系起来，从而能够预测涂层性能。
infographic.watch_item: 所报告的最优条件具有特定工艺和材料属性，因此迁移到其他喷涂系统、基体或涂层化学体系时需要验证。

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: UNSM altered the local hardness of Cr3C2–NiCr coatings in a strongly sample-dependent way, with DS and HVOF deposits showing different hardness ranges and peak conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study helps guide post-spray surface enhancement strategies for wear-resistant coatings by linking process route and UNSM settings to near-surface mechanical response.
method: Detonation-sprayed (DS) and HVOF Cr3C2–NiCr coatings were post-processed by UNSM.
Four samples per route were tested at 20/30 N static loads and 20/30 µm vibration amplitudes.
Hardness was measured by instrumented indentation at 300 mN with a 10 s dwell; scratch-induced surface morphology was examined by SEM.
infographic.evidence_signal: DS samples showed 820–970 HV and HVOF samples 546–1165 HV, with the highest hardness at DS-T1 (20 N/20 µm) and HVOF-T4 (30 N/30 µm); SEM after scratching showed heterogeneous contrast and crack-like features.
infographic.watch_item: The scratch observations are qualitative and do not isolate UNSM-caused damage or establish a definitive scratch-resistance ranking.
infographic.paper_title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION

zh-Hans.title: 超声纳米晶表面改性后 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 对经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）处理的 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层在爆轰喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）沉积条件下的硬度及划痕后表面形貌进行了研究。针对每种沉积路线评估了 4 个处理样品，静载荷分别为 20 和 30 N，振动幅值分别为 20 和 30 µm。采用 300 mN 载荷、10 s 保载时间进行仪器化硬度测量。DS 样品的硬度为 820–970 HV，而 HVOF 样品的硬度范围更宽，为 546–1165 HV。最高值分别记录于 20 N/20 µm 条件下的 DS-T1 以及 30 N/30 µm 条件下的 HVOF-T4。划痕测试后获取的 SEM 视场在两组涂层中均显示出非均匀表面对比度和类似裂纹的不连续特征。这些观察为测试后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但并未将损伤归因于 UNSM，也未建立划痕抗力的排序。作为补充观察，报告了 6 个处理样品的平均摩擦系数。结果表明，硬度响应具有样品依赖性，并强调需要将局部力学性能与表面完整性结合评估。

infographic.key_insight: UNSM 以强烈的样品依赖方式改变了 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层的局部硬度，DS 和 HVOF 沉积层表现出不同的硬度范围和峰值条件。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究通过将工艺路线和 UNSM 参数与近表面力学响应联系起来，有助于指导耐磨涂层的喷涂后表面强化策略。
method: 采用 UNSM 对爆轰喷涂（DS）和 HVOF 的 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层进行后处理。
每种工艺路线选取 4 个样品，在 20/30 N 静载荷和 20/30 µm 振动幅值条件下测试。
采用仪器化压痕法在 300 mN 载荷、10 s 保载时间下测量硬度；并通过 SEM 观察划痕引起的表面形貌。
infographic.evidence_signal: DS 样品硬度为 820–970 HV，HVOF 样品为 546–1165 HV，其中最高硬度分别出现在 DS-T1（20 N/20 µm）和 HVOF-T4（30 N/30 µm）；划痕后 SEM 显示出非均匀对比度和类似裂纹特征。
